NAME
  sprint four-dx commitments links set — Explicit issue UUID/ticket aliases and sprint IDs use an independent link revision from list. Set replaces only links; resolve-text previews exact references. No issue state or 4DX measurement is inferred.

SYNOPSIS
  sprint four-dx commitments links set --json-data OBJECT | --file PATH --expected-revision REVISION [FLAGS]

DESCRIPTION
  Explicit issue UUID/ticket aliases and sprint IDs use an independent link revision from list. Set replaces only links; resolve-text previews exact references. No issue state or 4DX measurement is inferred.

EXAMPLES
  sprint four-dx commitments links set --file input.json --expected-revision REVISION

POSITIONAL ARGUMENTS
  None; see SYNOPSIS for required input flags.

FLAGS
  --expected-revision REVISION (required; see SYNOPSIS)
  --json-data OBJECT | --file PATH
